name: Vistar Amar Ltd
tagline: Cheap debt-free fishmeal microcap with a strong long-term record but a deteriorating recent quarter and commodity-volatile margins — no catalyst, filtered to 'neither'
business_overview: Vistar Amar manufactures fishmeal and processes/trades fish, meat, dairy, poultry and agricultural products. Microcap, commodity-adjacent (monsoon/marine-catch dependent). No usable ValuePickr thread found; web/news + old-project baseline only.
fundamentals_table: ~57% 10-yr median sales growth; ~33% 5-yr PAT CAGR — but Q4 FY26 saw a sharp profit decline on revenue contraction
fundamentals_narrative: The long-term record looks strong on paper (57% 10-yr median sales growth, 33% 5-yr PAT CAGR, ROCE ~25%, debt-free, cheap) but the 3-year ROE is only ~12% and the most recent quarter (Q4 FY26) showed a sharp profit decline alongside revenue contraction, with rising debtor days. Quarterly margins swing widely with fish-catch and input costs. No specific forward catalyst was identified.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. 52-week range Rs 91-238 — a very wide band, consistent with the commodity-driven earnings volatility.
sentiment_summary: No usable ValuePickr thread found (one rate-limited forum search returned only unrelated topics). Web-only write-up, corroborated by third-party result commentary noting 'explosive revenue growth masks fundamental concerns' (Q3 FY26) and a 'sharp profit decline amid revenue contraction' (Q4 FY26). Old 108-stock project (2026-08-15, frozen) rated it Tier B, 'moderate conviction.'
community_signal: No ValuePickr community coverage located; no trusted-roster signal.
bull_case: Cheap, debt-free microcap with a strong multi-year growth and return record
High trailing ROCE (~25%) when the cycle is favourable
Small base (~Rs 100-120 Cr) leaves headroom if margins normalise upward
bear_case: Q4 FY26 profit fell sharply on revenue contraction — a negative recent inflection, not a positive one
Highly volatile quarterly margins reflect real commodity / marine-catch / input-cost exposure
3-year ROE only ~12% despite the flattering 10-year headline growth; debtor days rising
No specific forward catalyst and no independent ValuePickr scrutiny
verdict_headline: Strong long-term record undercut by a deteriorating recent quarter and commodity-volatile margins — 'neither' with no catalyst
verdict_reasoning: Trailing growth/returns are attractive but the 3-year ROE (~12%) and a Q4 FY26 profit + revenue contraction show the recent trend turning down
Margins are structurally commodity-volatile and there is no identified forward trigger, so this does not clear the open-screen bar
Old 108-stock project rated it Tier B; re-derived under the open-screen thesis it is 'neither' — the negative recent inflection and lack of catalyst are decisive

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: 'a Q4 FY26 profit + revenue contraction show the recent trend turning down' (tailwind=no); 'margins are structurally commodity-volatile and there is no identified forward trigger' (moat=no).
